theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  classical
  let f : ℕ → ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ := fun n => (u n, u (n + 1), u (n + 2), u (n + 3))
  have h_fin : Set.Finite (Set.range f) := by
    have h_sub : Set.range f ⊆ Set.Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T) := by
      intro x hx; rcases hx with ⟨n, rfl⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_Icc, Set.mem_range, Prod.mk.injEq]
      exact ⟨hB n, hB (n+1), hB (n+2), hB (n+3)⟩
    exact Set.Finite.subset (Set.finite_mem_finset (Finset.Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T))) h_sub
  have h_not_inj : ¬Function.Injective f := by
    intro h_inj
    have h_inf : Set.Infinite (Set.range f) := Set.infinite_range_of_injective h_inj
    exact Set.not_infinite.mpr h_fin h_inf
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, h_eq⟩ := h_not_inj
  have h_lt : i < j ∨ j < i := by omega
  cases h_lt with
  | inl h_lt =>
    have h_per : ∀ m, u (i + m) = u (j + m) := by
      intro m
      induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | h m ih =>
        match m with
        | 0 => exact h_eq.1
        | 1 => exact h_eq.2.1
        | 2 => exact h_eq.2.2.1
        | 3 => exact h_eq.2.2.2
        | m + 4 =>
          have h₁ : u (i + m + 4) = ((u (i + m + 3) + u (i + m + 2) + u (i + m + 1) * u (i + m)) : ℝ) / (u (i + m + 3) * u (i + m + 2) + u (i + m + 1) + u (i + m)) := by
            have h₂ := hu (i + m + 4) (by omega)
            exact h₂.1
          have h₂ : u (j + m + 4) = ((u (j + m + 3) + u (j + m + 2) + u (j + m + 1) * u (j + m)) : ℝ) / (u (j + m + 3) * u (j + m + 2) + u (j + m + 1) + u (j + m)) := by
            have h₃ := hu (j + m + 4) (by omega)
            exact h₃.1
          rw [h₁, h₂]
          simp only [ih _ (by omega), ih _ (by omega), ih _ (by omega), ih _ (by omega)]
    use i, j - i
    constructor <;> simp_all
    intro n hn
    have h₁ := h_per (n - i)
    have h₂ : i + (n - i) = n := by omega
    have h₃ : j + (n - i) = n + (j - i) := by omega
    rw [h₂] at h₁
    rw [h₃] at h₁
    exact h₁
  | inr h_lt =>
    have h_per : ∀ m, u (j + m) = u (i + m) := by
      intro m
      induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | h m ih =>
        match m with
        | 0 => exact h_eq.1
        | 1 => exact h_eq.2.1
        | 2 => exact h_eq.2.2.1
        | 3 => exact h_eq.2.2.2
        | m + 4 =>
          have h₁ : u (j + m + 4) = ((u (j + m + 3) + u (j + m + 2) + u (j + m + 1) * u (j + m)) : ℝ) / (u (j + m + 3) * u (j + m + 2) + u (j + m + 1) + u (j + m)) := by
            have h₂ := hu (j + m + 4) (by omega)
            exact h₂.1
          have h₂ : u (i + m + 4) = ((u (i + m + 3) + u (i + m + 2) + u (i + m + 1) * u (i + m)) : ℝ) / (u (i + m + 3) * u (i + m + 2) + u (i + m + 1) + u (i + m)) := by
            have h₃ := hu (i + m + 4) (by omega)
            exact h₃.1
          rw [h₁, h₂]
          simp only [ih _ (by omega), ih _ (by omega), ih _ (by omega), ih _ (by omega)]
    use j, i - j
    constructor <;> simp_all
    intro n hn
    have h₁ := h_per (n - j)
    have h₂ : j + (n - j) = n := by omega
    have h₃ : i + (n - j) = n + (i - j) := by omega
    rw [h₂] at h₁
    rw [h₃] at h₁
    exact h₁
